subject: Avoid having server.h being included by cli and benchmark (#3420)
reason: Pure refactor with no behavior change: the diff moves the COMMAND_* and CMD_* macro definitions verbatim from server.h to commands.h so cli/benchmark need not include server.h, swaps server.h for stdint.h/zmalloc.h/util.h includes in crc16.c and fuzzer_command_generator.c, and reformats the crc16 table and loop with identical values and logic. No command reply, protocol, replication, persistence, cluster-slot hashing, or tool output changes, so no scenario can observe a difference between the builds.
